t: A free tool where learners train a text or image classifier and use it in Scratch.
steps: Open the LearningML site and choose the online editor or the desktop download.
Try the editor yourself with a small set of labeled images.
Train a model and test it on new examples.
Check whether students need accounts. The homepage does not describe them.
Ask IT about the desktop download if the school blocks browser tools.
Plan a short class activity with two or three labels.
